title: Media Transmission Technology
definition: The systematic process of sending, propagating, and receiving analog or digital information signals (audio, video, data) across physical or wireless communication channels over geographic distances.
importanceInUpsc: Directly links to Science & Technology (IT, Communication, Space tech), national security, digital divide, public broadcasting reforms (Prasar Bharati), spectrum management, and digital infrastructure expansion under GS Paper III.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Media Transmission Technology.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
